items.title: Cencora raises full-year guidance after stronger-than-expected third-quarter results
items.summary: Cencora (NYSE:COR) reported third-quarter results that exceeded Wall Street expectations, prompting the pharmaceutical services company to raise its full-year earnings guidance. The stronger performance helped lift the shares more than 3% in pre-market trading.

items.title: Cencora (COR) Surpasses Q3 Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Cencora (COR) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.52% and -0.16%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Cencora’s (NYSE:COR) Q2 CY2026 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
items.summary: Healthcare distributor Cencora (NYSE:COR) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.1% year on year to $84.75 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.48 per share was 3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: What's in Store for These 4 Healthcare Companies This Earnings Season?
items.summary: McKesson, Cencora, Solventum and PacBio head into earnings with resilient demand offset by tariffs, funding pressure and pricing challenges.

items.title: DENTSPLY SIRONA to Post Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: XRAY's Q2 results are likely to reflect transformation investments, dealer inventory cuts and weak implants, while Wellspect growth offers support.

items.title: Cencora to Report Q3 Earnings: Is a Beat Likely for the Stock?
items.summary: COR's Q3 results could reflect specialty pharma strength, oncology expansion and margin gains, even as pricing dynamics and GLP-1 trends pressure revenues.

items.title: Can AI-Driven Efficiency and Specialty Demand Boost MCK's Q1 Results?
items.summary: McKesson heads into Q1 with AI-driven efficiency, specialty momentum and oncology growth in focus as pricing dynamics may temper revenues.

items.title: Solventum to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: SOLV's Q2 results are likely to benefit from segment strength, Acera gains and cost savings, offset by tariffs and ERP-related sales timing shifts.
